newsitem.title: SWEDEN: FORECAST - SKF '96 profit seen 2.43 bln skr.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - SKF '96 profit seen 2.43 bln skr.

text.p: Swedish bearings maker AB SKF is expected to post a lower profit after financial items for 1996 of 2.43 billion crowns compared to 3.33 billion crowns the previous year, a Reuter poll of 16 analysts showed on Tuesday.
Forecasts varied between 2.22 billion and 2.69 billion crowns but the average forecast showed profit after financial items would be 27 percent lower on 1995.
The average of 14 analysts' forecasts showed SKF was expected to report profit per share of 13.20 crowns against 17.95 crowns in 1995.
SKF was expected to propose a dividend for 1996 of 5.32 crowns compared to 5.25 crowns a year earlier.

Analysts interviewed for the poll were from Nordiska, Paribas, James Capel, Fischer, Swedbank, Handelsbanken, Enskilda, Foreningsbanken, Carnegie, Kleinwort Benson, Morgan Grenfell, Fiba Nordic, UBS, Goldman Sachs, Penser and Aros.
SKF is due to release 1996 data on February 6.
